difficulties.zh: 调用成本 —— 每次发送完整历史记录，会使长对话的 API 费用持续增加。

difficulties.zh: 响应等待 —— 输入内容越长，模型开始返回文字前的处理时间可能越久。
difficulties.en: Response time — Longer inputs can increase the wait before the model begins responding.

difficulties.zh: 指令遗漏 —— 资料过多时，模型可能忽略夹在中间的重要指令。
difficulties.en: Missed instructions — A model may overlook important instructions within a large body of material.

intro.zh: 先评估现有流程的成本、使用频率和预期收益，再确定开发范围与合作方式。三种模式的交付内容和维护责任如下。
intro.en: We assess current costs, usage and expected benefits before agreeing on scope. The three options below differ in what you receive and who operates the system.

title.zh: 回答三个问题，查看建议起步方式

label.zh: 1. 这项工作在团队内的发生频率？
label.en: 1. How often does your team run this workflow?

label.zh: 每天高频发生，多人协同使用
每周或按项目周期成批发生
label.en: Weekly or in recurring project batches

label.zh: 刚准备引入 AI，想先测一个场景
label.en: Exploring AI—want to validate one task first

label.zh: 2. 你们希望由谁来运行和维护系统？
label.en: 2. Who should operate the workflow day to day?

label.zh: 希望沉淀自有系统，内部团队长期使用
label.en: We want our own system for internal staff

label.zh: 先用轻量化服务跑通，有效再长期持有
label.en: Start lightweight, decide ownership after results

label.zh: 不设技术运维岗，直接把成批任务委托交付
label.en: No internal tech ops—deliver reviewed outputs to us

label.zh: 3. 现有历史资料与验收标准的清晰程度？
label.en: 3. How ready are your source documents and review rules?

label.zh: 资料与审批标准较明确，可直接对接系统
label.en: Sources and approval rules are well defined

label.zh: 有历史样本，但需先梳理规则并测算准确率
label.en: We have samples, but need to test accuracy first

applyCta.zh: 带此结果预约 30–45 分钟评估
applyCta.en: Discuss this option in a 30–45 min call

detail.zh: 梳理目标、流程与数据，一周内给出评估结论。
detail.en: Review goals, workflows and data, with an assessment within one week.

detail.zh: 估算人工、外包与返工成本，比较预期收益，确定开发顺序。
detail.en: Estimate current costs and expected benefits to prioritize development.

detail.zh: 确认项目范围、合作方式、验收标准与报价。
detail.en: Agree scope, engagement, acceptance criteria and price.

detail.zh: 按约定节奏交付工具、工作流或批量成果。
detail.en: Deliver working tools, workflows or batch results on the agreed schedule.

detail.zh: 处理使用反馈与故障，按约定更新资料和功能。
detail.en: Address user feedback and faults, and update sources and features as agreed.

body.zh: 在隔离的云端环境中使用系统，按使用量扩展资源，适合试点和较轻的工作负载。
body.en: Use the system in an isolated cloud environment, with resources scaled to usage. Suitable for pilots and lighter workloads.

body.zh: 模型与数据在你的环境中运行。交付 Docker 部署配置，并适配本地算力；部署要求在项目开始前确认。
body.en: Run models and data inside your environment. We provide Docker deployment configurations and adapt them to local compute, with requirements agreed before the project starts.

q.zh: 应该完整定制，还是从试点开始？

a.zh: 需求明确且使用频繁时，可以规划完整系统。对效果或使用量还没有把握时，先用小范围试点测试，再决定是否扩展。
a.en: A full build suits clear requirements and frequent use. If results or likely usage remain uncertain, test a smaller scope in a pilot before expanding.

q.zh: 什么时候适合托管式 AI 服务？
q.en: When does managed service make sense?

a.zh: 适合希望按批次委托工作、暂不准备自行维护系统的团队。客户提供资料与标准，Cyano 运行 AI 工作流并审核结果。
a.en: It suits teams that want to outsource recurring work without operating a system. You supply sources and criteria; Cyano runs the AI workflow and reviews the output.

a.zh: 我们会梳理操作步骤、数据来源和参与人员，估算改造成本与预期收益，给出建议范围和实施顺序。
a.en: We review the process, data sources and people involved, estimate costs and benefits, and recommend a scope and implementation sequence.

q.zh: 如何获得适合自己的方案？
q.en: How do we get a tailored proposal?

a.zh: 联系我们后，我们会根据业务价值、技术复杂度、使用规模和上线节奏，给出贴合实际的建议与报价。
a.en: Talk to us. We tailor the recommendation and quote to your business value, technical complexity, scale and timeline.

a.zh: 支持私有化部署，数据不出你的环境；系统内置权限控制、全链路日志审计与敏感信息拦截。
a.en: Private deployment keeps data inside your environment. Every system includes access control, full audit logs and sensitive-data filtering.

a.zh: 三种模式都包含上线后的维护。定制开发和试点的维护、迭代范围在合作时约定；托管服务的运行与交付由 Cyano 负责。
a.en: All three options include maintenance. The scope of support and further development is agreed for builds and pilots; Cyano operates and delivers the managed service.

q.zh: 如果效果不达预期怎么办？

a.zh: 试点开始前，双方约定验收标准。根据实际结果判断需要补充资料、调整流程还是停止试点，再决定是否扩大投入。
a.en: Agree on acceptance criteria before the pilot. Use the results to decide whether to improve the sources, change the workflow or stop before investing further.

scopeBody.zh: 销售咨询需要产品参数与项目记录；标书生成需要模板、引用和审核要求；数据查询需要明确指标与访问权限。我们根据每类工作的条件设计系统，并在上线后维护。
scopeBody.en: Sales inquiries need specifications and project records. Proposals need templates, sources and review criteria. Data queries need agreed metrics and access controls. We design for those requirements and maintain the system after launch.

body.zh: 开发前核对工作量、资料条件和预期改善，确定是否值得投入。
body.en: Review workload, source quality and expected improvements before committing to development.

body.zh: 在项目开始前明确系统要完成的任务、审核方式与上线条件。
body.en: Define the tasks, review process and launch requirements before development.

body.zh: 使用企业提供的资料，并将关键结论与来源关联，方便核查。
body.en: Use company material and link key statements to their sources for review.

body.zh: 根据资料、业务规则和模型变化更新系统，持续处理使用反馈。
body.en: Update the system as sources, business rules and models change, and address user feedback.

title.zh: 联系我们，讨论你的项目

intro.zh: 告诉我们目前如何完成这项工作、需要多少时间，以及希望改进什么。有现成的工作样本即可开始讨论，不必先写完整的需求文档。
intro.en: Tell us how you do the work today, how long it takes and what you want to improve. A work sample is enough to begin; a full requirements document can come later.

topicsTitle.zh: 需求评估、保密演示或技术架构交流
topicsTitle.en: Scope assessment, NDA demos or architecture fit

body.zh: 一起梳理目标、操作步骤、数据条件和成本，判断适合定制、试点还是托管。
body.en: review goals, process, data and costs to choose between a custom build, pilot or managed service.

body.zh: 可安排与你业务相近的案例演示，完整系统演示需签署保密协议。
body.en: arrange a demo relevant to your business. Full system walkthroughs require an NDA.

body.zh: 数据接入、权限、私有化部署、模型选择和后续维护，都可以先聊。
body.en: data access, permissions, private deployment, model choice and maintenance.

responderTitle.zh: 谁会阅读并回复你的咨询

responderBody.zh: 资深顾问会阅读你的描述，并与你确认资料、时间和项目需求。
responderBody.en: A senior consultant will review your inquiry and follow up about source material, timing and project requirements.

nextSteps.zh: 1 个工作日内回复，约一次 30–45 分钟的沟通。
nextSteps.en: We reply within one business day to set up a 30–45 minute call.

nextSteps.zh: 一周内给出需求评估结论和合作建议。
nextSteps.en: Within a week, we provide an assessment and a recommended way to proceed.

nextSteps.zh: 你决定是否推进，我们给出范围与报价。
nextSteps.en: You decide whether to proceed; we provide scope and a quote.

body.zh: 你要找的页面不存在或已经移动。
body.en: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

title.zh: 销售、文档、知识库与数据查询
title.en: AI for sales, documents, knowledge and data

intro.zh: 我们根据工作频率、资料条件和审核要求，评估哪些环节适合使用 AI。你可以选择定制系统、先做一个试点，或委托我们持续处理任务。
intro.en: We assess where AI can help by looking at task frequency, available sources and review requirements. We can build a system, start with a pilot or handle recurring work as a managed service.

opportunities.zh: 扩展客户服务 —— 根据产品资料与客户需求，提供个性化推荐、客户分析和销售材料。标签：客户筛选 · 客群分析 · 个性化销售材料 · 新增服务能力
opportunities.en: Expand customer services — use product information and customer needs to prepare recommendations, profiles and sales materials. Tags: Prospect selection · Customer analysis · Personalized sales materials · New services

opportunities.zh: 减少重复处理 —— 将文档整理、审核、查询和客服等重复步骤接入 AI 工作流，减少手工操作与等待。标签：文档自动化 · 合同与合规审查 · 内部知识问答 · 数据查询与运营
opportunities.en: Reduce repetitive work — use AI workflows for recurring steps in document preparation, review, queries and support. Tags: Document automation · Contract & compliance review · Internal Q&A · Data & operations

other.zh: 我们也承接房产管理、长篇内容创作等行业定制项目。可以结合现有工作样本，讨论适合你的方案。
other.en: We also build systems for property management, long-form writing and other specialized work. Bring a sample of your current work so we can discuss a suitable approach.

title.zh: 六个客户项目的界面与成果
title.en: Six client projects: systems and results

intro.zh: 这些案例来自 Cyano 为企业客户交付的项目。界面中的客户信息与数据已按保密要求脱敏。签署保密协议后，可由工程师演示完整系统。
intro.en: These projects were built for enterprise clients. Client information and data in the screenshots have been anonymized. An engineer can demonstrate the full system under NDA.
